name: protein A (RdRp)
note: The replicase, translated from genomic RNA1. Its N-terminal 46 residues are sufficient for mitochondrial localisation and membrane insertion (PMID 12208963); replication occurs on outer mitochondrial membranes (PMID 11689648). No cleavage product of protein A is described in any nodavirus.

name: B1
note: In-frame C-terminal fragment of protein A, translated from an internal AUG on subgenomic RNA3. NOT a cleavage product. PMID 15163762: 'Protein B1 is in the same reading frame as protein A and thus represents its C-terminal fragment'; detected as protein for Nodamura by SDS-PAGE and MALDI-TOF.

name: B2
note: RNA silencing suppressor in the +1 frame relative to protein A, on sgRNA3. Nodamura makes two forms, B2-134 and B2-137, from the first and second AUG of RNA3.

name: capsid precursor alpha
note: The RNA2 product, 395-407 aa, which assembles and then cleaves itself.

name: mature capsid beta
note: alpha residues 1 to the Asn of the autocatalytic site; 363 aa in FHV. Derived here by chemistry on each genome's own alpha.

name: gamma peptide
note: alpha from the residue after the cut to its C-terminus; 44 aa in FHV, 40 aa in Pariacoto at an Asn/Ser site. Forms a pentameric helical bundle at the fivefold axes and is required for membrane disruption during entry.

name: Pariacoto minor capsid (second-AUG form)
note: A real virion protein in Pariacoto only, initiated at the SECOND AUG of the capsid ORF and 24 residues shorter than alpha. It is alpha minus an N-terminal run, so it is 100% identical to alpha over its entire length and no profile can separate the two. Deliberately not declared; recorded in NOT_CALLABLE.md.

name: BBV RNA2 second ORF (URF)
note: A 72 aa open reading frame predicted at base 1110 of BBV RNA2 in 1984, with no product reported in the 40 years since. One deposit family-wide. Excluded by name, not modelled.
